Workflow Templates for Small Teams

Workflow templates help small teams repeat good work. A workflow template is a reusable checklist with clear steps.

These workflow templates cover planning, review and handoff. Each workflow template names an owner and a due date.

Why reusable workflow templates matter

Reusable workflow templates cut setup time. Teams copy a workflow template, fill the blanks, and start.

Use workflow templates for weekly planning and for project handoff notes.
